SAMPLE: An AI controller holds a plasma steady in a test machine
SAMPLE page, invented for tests and never fetched. Fernhill Fusion Group (SAMPLE). An AI controller, the Fernhill Controller, held a plasma steady in a test machine for 90 seconds, three times longer than the standard controller. The controller, built by Fernhill Fusion Group, adjusted the magnets 1,000 times a second. It learned from practice runs. Other groups have not yet repeated the run. The Fernhill Controller was trained by reinforcement learning.
